items.title: Cerebras: The AI Hardware Giant Facing Imminent Collapse
items.raw_excerpt: Post by ex-employee. In the cutthroat AI world, Cerebras Systems, despite colossal wafers and bold claims, faces collapse. Its fragile foundation stems from brittle hardware, astonishingly narrow in practical application. Optimized primarily for LLaMA model finetuning, touted "speed boosts" often use speculative decoding, masking that many "supported" models run inefficiently, if at all. This rigidity mirrors a Formula 1 engine demanding one fuel under lab conditions. This compounds with a poorly conceived software and kernel stack. The current infrastructure restricts Cerebras systems almost exclusively to LLaMA-family transformer LLMs. Modern vision pipelines, diffusion models, or other AI paradigms are beyond reach. In a rapidly evolving field, this narrow focus is a death sentence. A c

title_i18n.zh: Cerebras：濒临崩溃的人工智能硬件巨头
title_i18n.es: Cerebras: El gigante del hardware de IA al borde del colapso inminente

excerpt_i18n.en: Post by ex-employee. In the cutthroat AI world, Cerebras Systems, despite colossal wafers and bold claims, faces collapse. Its fragile foundation stems from brittle hardware, astonishingly narrow in practical application. Optimized primarily for LLaMA model finetuning, touted "speed boosts" often use speculative decoding, masking that many "supported" models run inefficiently, if at all. This rigidity mirrors a Formula 1 engine demanding one fuel under lab conditions. This compounds with a poorly conceived software and kernel stack. The current infrastructure restricts Cerebras systems almost exclusively to LLaMA-family transformer LLMs. Modern vision pipelines, diffusion models, or other AI paradigms are beyond reach. In a rapidly evolving field, this narrow focus is a death sentence. A c

excerpt_i18n.es: Publicación de un ex empleado. En el competitivo mundo de la IA, Cerebras Systems, a pesar de sus obleas colosales y afirmaciones audaces, se enfrenta al colapso. Su frágil base proviene de un hardware quebradizo, asombrosamente limitado en aplicaciones prácticas.

items.title: 奥特曼拟通过 Sora 实现 AI 视频生成商业化
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI 首席执行官山姆・奥特曼在一篇博客文章中表示：“用户生成的视频内容数量远超我们预期，而且许多视频的受众规模非常小。”“我们必须通过某种方式让视频生成业务实现盈利。”奥特曼称，公司计划与希望用户生成其角色的版权方分享部分收入。具体的盈利模式还需经过反复尝试（才能确定），相关计划将很快启动。

title_i18n.zh: 奥特曼拟通过 Sora 实现 AI 视频生成商业化
title_i18n.en: OpenAI plans to commercialize AI video generation through Sora.
title_i18n.es: OpenAI planea comercializar la generación de vídeos con IA mediante Sora.

excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI 首席执行官山姆・奥特曼在一篇博客文章中表示：“用户生成的视频内容数量远超我们预期，而且许多视频的受众规模非常小。”“我们必须通过某种方式让视频生成业务实现盈利。”奥特曼称，公司计划与希望用户生成其角色的版权方分享部分收入。具体的盈利模式还需经过反复尝试（才能确定），相关计划将很快启动。
excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated in a blog post that the volume of user-generated video content has far exceeded their expectations, with many videos reaching very small audiences. He emphasized the need to make the video generation business profitable in some way. Altman mentioned that the company plans to share a portion of revenue with copyright holders who wish to have users generate their characters. The specific profit model will require repeated experimentation to determine, and the related plans are set to launch soon.
excerpt_i18n.es: El director ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman, señaló en una entrada de blog que la cantidad de contenido de video generado por usuarios supera con creces sus expectativas y que muchas de estas producciones tienen audiencias muy reducidas. Afirmó que es necesario encontrar una forma de hacer rentable el negocio de generación de videos. La empresa planea compartir parte de los ingresos con los titulares de derechos que deseen que los usuarios creen sus personajes. El modelo específico de monetización aún requiere pruebas iterativas para definirse, y se espera que los planes comiencen pronto.
